pairs.title: Chedi Steps · 반지
pairs.prompt: Ring original design declaration: a Chedi Steps band translating architecture-first steps and window voids into a low-profile form under 3 mm. Warm untreated brass (clear sealed) shows through, with satin-brushed planes contrasted by micro-blasted, darker recesses for depth. The master motif is a repeating three-level step rhythm wrapping 70% of the circumference, punctuated by narrow “window” channels; every outside edge has ~0.25 mm radius to feel soft yet catch light crisply. Unisex proportion: ~4.5 mm band width, stackable, with a comfort-fit inner curve. Real manufacturing specs: minimum wall 1.4 mm, flat top thickness 2.6–2.9 mm, inside chamfer for finger stability. One tiny 1.2 mm recycled-glass dot is flush-set, centered within a step plateau; optional micro enamel inlays sit 0.3 mm deep, no prongs, no multiple stones. Three-quarter product view, achromatic studio background, macro jewelry photo, photoreal realism, sharp focus, true brass color, soft diffused key light. Avoid: deity or head motifs, exotic or “Oriental” wording, amulet or power claims, overly ornate royal motifs, boho hammered texture cliches, gendered labels.

insight.meaning: A unisex brass ring that abstracts Thai Buddhist temple geometry into clean stacking, tapering and tiering suitable for everyday casual wear within a sub 1000 THB price point. The design language borrows from chedi stupa volumes that enshrine relics and symbolize enlightenment, and from Khmer derived prang towers adapted in Thailand, translated into simple stepped and fluted profiles rather than figurative motifs. ([thailandfoundation.or.th](https://thailandfoundation.or.th/th/understanding-thai-buddhist-architecture/))
insight.cultural: Asia focus with country notes · Thailand Chedi relic towers and prang towers are core silhouettes in Thai temple precincts and carry connotations of merit making, protection and cosmological order. Naga serpent balustrades mark thresholds and protection. Avoid casual use of Buddha images in fashion because many Thais view that as disrespectful. ([ora.ox.ac.uk](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid%3A8da96d37-deb8-4604-acb7-3574bd078ec7/files/dsb3979233)) · China Red and gold signal auspiciousness, celebration and status, which can be echoed through warm brass and small red accents. ([asia-archive.si.edu](https://asia-archive.si.edu/red/)) · Japan Vermilion architecture at temples and shrine gates is associated with protection and wood preservation through cinnabar pigment, and is culturally iconic. Use vermilion accents with restraint and avoid the manji swastika symbol in export facing visuals because it is easily misread in Western contexts. ([faq.japan-travel.jnto.go.jp](https://faq.japan-travel.jnto.go.jp/en/uk/inspiration/the-many-types-of-torii-in-japan/)) · Korea Dancheong temple painting uses five cardinal colors tied to yin yang and five elements; lotus and geometric borders are common. A restrained five color micro palette can reference this without pastiche. ([korea.net](https://www.korea.net/NewsFocus/Culture/view?articleId=191572)) · India and Sri Lanka Lotus purity and dharma wheel meaning are pan Buddhist; Sri Lankan Theravada stupas inform Thai chedi forms, so stacked lotus bases and bell domes read correctly across South and Southeast Asia. ([asia-archive.si.edu](https://asia-archive.si.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/ArtofBuddhism1.pdf))
insight.background: Key temple forms to abstract · Chedi stupa bell or lotus bud domes on tiered bases to enshrine relics and commemorate enlightenment and the spread of the teaching. ([thailandfoundation.or.th](https://thailandfoundation.or.th/th/understanding-thai-buddhist-architecture/)) · Prang Khmer derived vertical tower later adapted in Sukhothai and Ayutthaya, often brick or laterite with stucco and niches. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prang_%28architecture%29)) · Temple roof grammar multi tiered eaves with chofa finials and serrated bai raka along the gable; motifs reference Garuda and Naga. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thai_temple_art_and_architecture)) · Surface culture mirrored glass and porcelain mosaic cladding on monuments like Wat Arun create rhythmic micro geometry that can inspire fine engraved or enamel tiles on metal. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wat_Arun)) · Spatial ritual clockwise circumambulation around stupas suggests circular motion and repetition that can inform band rhythm. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circumambulation)) · Dominant school Thai Buddhism is Theravada from a Sri Lankan lineage, explaining shared chedi profiles and lotus bases. ([smarthistory.org](https://smarthistory.org/thai-buddhist-monasteries/))

Shallow flutes or facets aligned to the eightfold symmetry of the dharma wheel
motion: Clockwise band rhythm with repeating step modules that invite thumb circling like circumambulation
Vertical thrust that resolves at a calm plateau top surface

cliches: Literal Buddha head rings or pendants

cautions: Respect norms in Thailand Buddha images are sacred and casual decorative use on fashion items off body or on body is considered offensive by many. Favor abstract architecture instead of Buddha figures or scriptures. ([thailand.go.th](https://thailand.go.th/useful-information-detail/009_151?hl=en))

Avoid the manji swastika graphic in international packaging and ads even when intended as Buddhist because it is widely misread outside Asia. ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jan/20/japan-to-drop-the-swastika-from-its-tourist-maps))

If referencing yantra geometry from Sak Yant traditions do not include mantras or magical diagrams out of context; consult cultural experts if any sacred text is proposed. ([thailandfoundation.or.th](https://www.thailandfoundation.or.th/yantra-from-sacred-geometry-to-sacred-tattoos/))

Color sensitivity saffron robe hues carry monastic association in Theravada contexts; use adjacent ochers rather than exact robe tones for branding or straps. ([bhikkhuni.net](https://www.bhikkhuni.net/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Yavaprabhas_10050009_thesis.pdf))

Skin safety brass and other copper alloys can tarnish and cause green staining; some consumers react to nickel in platings or findings. Offer clear care guidance and avoid nickel releasing components per EU thresholds when exporting. ([edu.rsc.org](https://edu.rsc.org/everyday-chemistry/why-does-copper-jewellery-turn-your-skin-green/4020461.article))
Lead and nickel free claims must be verified with supplier specifications and migration tests when required. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2006/1907/2024-06-06/eng))

sets.name: Chedi Steps
sets.concept: Stepped geometry of Thai chedi tiers distilled into modular low profile brass forms for casual unisex wear priced under 1000 THB.
sets.story: The design captures the quiet rhythm of temple terraces rising from base to finial. Planes and shadows replace ornament to hint at gilded stupas without using sacred icons. Negative cuts recall lattice windows and tiled courtyards while preserving a calm graphic presence. The pieces stay slim and durable for everyday movement and suit ages twenty two to twenty nine across Asia.
sets.metal: Lead free brass in a natural warm gold tone with optional antique patina in recesses.
sets.surface: Satin brushed planes with micro sandblasted steps and a clear lacquer or microcrystalline wax seal to slow tarnish.
sets.stones: No precious stones. Optional 1.5 mm round black glass cabochon or a 0.5 by 3 mm rectangular recycled green glass micro inlay set flush.
sets.silhouette: A low stepped trapezoid bar shared by ring top and a vertical pendant with a small apex notch.
sets.motif: A three level tiered chedi step module expressed as stacked planes.
sets.rhythm: Vertical mirror symmetry with a three step progression repeated one to three times and edges eased to a 0.3 mm radius for comfort.
sets.structure: Ring uses a hollow under gallery to reduce weight and a comfort band about 2.0 mm thick with an optional open end for size flexibility. Pendant is a vertical bar with a hidden jump ring channel behind the top step and works on cord or thin chain. Accent inlays sit in 0.6 mm deep channels or are flush set to avoid prongs. Total metal mass is kept light to meet the 1000 THB target.
avoid: gendered labels such as for men only or for women only
design_dna: Architecture first not iconography so we abstract steps and windows rather than depict figures.
Profiles stay low under 3 mm so the pieces sit flat against skin and do not snag on clothes.
Every edge is softened with a small radius for comfort yet reads crisp in light.
Contrast finishing is mandatory brushed planes against darker recess to create depth without extra cost.
Unisex proportion means moderate widths and neutral scale that stack or layer easily.
Accents use enamel or recycled glass micro inlays or a single tiny flush set glass dot never multiple prongs.
Brass remains visible and untreated wherever possible with a clear seal to maintain color and meet the under 1000 THB price.
Visual rhythm follows a three level step grammar that repeats consistently across ring and pendant.

sets.name: Gable Line
sets.concept: A soft chevron drawn from Thai temple gable and chofa lines turned into slim brass curves with optional black enamel or a tiny flush stone for easy unisex styling under 1000 THB.
sets.story: The set distills the sweeping roofline into a single nested V that feels graphic yet gentle. Curves skim the hand and chest so the pieces wear comfortably with tees and denim. Small accents echo lacquer and colored glass from temple facades while keeping the price approachable. The open geometry and adjustable options suit a wide size range for young urban wearers across Asia.
sets.metal: Lead free brass with a warm gold tone sealed with clear lacquer for daily wear.
sets.surface: High polish on ridge lines and satin brush on inner fields with 0.6 mm enamel channels or micro blasted valleys.
sets.stones: Optional single round 1.3 to 1.5 mm onyx or hematite flush set at the chevron apex. Enamel linework can replace stones to control cost.
sets.silhouette: A shallow V chevron with a gentle arc and open center used for both ring and pendant.
sets.motif: Abstract gable apex line expressed as one or two nested chevrons.
sets.rhythm: Strict left right mirror symmetry with equal spacing between nested lines and a consistent line weight that thickens slightly toward the apex for lift.
sets.structure: Ring features a slim split shank merging into the V apex and offers an open end size flex option. Pendant has a hidden bail cavity behind the apex and hangs at a slight tilt to echo roof pitch. Enamel or the micro stone sits at the focus point in a flush seat to avoid snags. Metal thickness stays around 1.6 to 2.0 mm to keep weight and cost low.
avoid: Buddha head or sacred figure depiction
touristy souvenir bling with heavy fake gold
gendered naming such as ladies ring or mens pendant
neon color pops that break the temple palette
design_dna: The chevron curve is the grammar every piece must reference with an open center that creates breath.
Line weight remains slim and continuous with a gentle taper toward the apex to suggest lift.
Edges are smooth and pocket friendly with micro chamfers for comfort.
Contrast is achieved through polish versus satin and a single black or blue accent delivered as enamel or one micro stone.
Pieces are stackable or layerable and never exceed medium scale to preserve unisex appeal.
Manufacturing favors single piece stamp or laser cut and bend operations with minimal solder joints to control price under 1000 THB.
All settings are flush or in channels no prongs to avoid snagging and to simplify maintenance.
Finish is sealed with lacquer to slow tarnish and maintain a consistent warm brass color.
Visual rhythm follows nested chevrons repeated once or twice only to keep the look clean for casual wear.
